Your updated screen is live at **http://maker:4001** — here's the one flow I'd like you to try:

1. Paste this link and press **"Get details"**, then **"Save bookmark"**: `https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Array/map` — it lands in your list.
2. Now paste **the exact same link again**, press **"Get details"**, then **"Save bookmark"**.
3. Watch what happens: instead of adding a second copy, the app **recognizes you already saved it**, brings that existing bookmark up in the editor (with a note explaining why), and **highlights it in your list**.
4. Change the note to something like `revisited` and press **"Update bookmark"** — your one entry updates in place; no duplicate appears.

A few choices I made here — please tell me if any feel off:

- **What "take me to the existing bookmark" looks like:** I load the existing one into the editor at the top *and* highlight it in the list, then the Save button becomes **"Update bookmark."** This was a judgment call on my part — if you pictured it differently (say, jumping straight down to edit it right where it sits in the list), tell me and I'll show you that version to compare.
- **What counts as "the same link":** I treat two links as the same page even if one has `http` vs `https`, a `www.`, a trailing `/`, or different capitalization in the site name. If you'd want stricter or looser matching, say so.
- **I also added a small "Edit" link on every saved item**, so you can update any bookmark directly — not only when you re-save a duplicate.
